import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Create Voronoi diagram, clip to bbox, and count educational institutions in Central's cell
query = text("""
WITH station_points AS (
    SELECT id, coordinate::geometry as geom
    FROM air_quality_station
),
bbox AS (
    SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(113.943659, 22.247461, 114.360719, 22.496697, 4326) as envelope
),
voronoi_raw AS (
    SELECT 
        (ST_Dump(ST_VoronoiPolygons(ST_Collect(geom)))).geom as voronoi_geom,
        ST_Collect(geom) as all_points
    FROM station_points
),
-- We need to associate each Voronoi cell with its generating station
-- Use the station point that is contained within each Voronoi cell
voronoi_with_station AS (
    SELECT 
        v.voronoi_geom,
        s.id as station_id
    FROM voronoi_raw v
    CROSS JOIN station_points s
    WHERE ST_Contains(v.voronoi_geom, s.geom)
),
voronoi_clipped AS (
    SELECT 
        vs.station_id,
        ST_Intersection(vs.voronoi_geom, b.envelope) as cell_geom
    FROM voronoi_with_station vs
    CROSS JOIN bbox b
),
central_cell AS (
    SELECT cell_geom
    FROM voronoi_clipped
    WHERE station_id = 16
),
educational_centroids AS (
    SELECT 
        id,
        name,
        ST_Centroid(geometry) as centroid
    FROM sensitive_area
    WHERE category = 'EDUCATIONAL_INSTITUTION'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as school_count
FROM educational_centroids ec
CROSS JOIN central_cell cc
WHERE ST_Contains(cc.cell_geom, ec.centroid)
""")
result = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(result)
